properties.name: app.default-user.username
properties.description: Username of the default account seeded by DataInitializer on the first startup.

properties.name: app.default-user.password
properties.description: Password of the default account seeded by DataInitializer on the first startup.

properties.name: app.family-users
properties.description: Comma-separated list of family member usernames seeded on the first startup.

properties.name: cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed by CORS. Use explicit origins, never a wildcard.

properties.name: groq.api.url
properties.description: Base URL of the Groq OpenAI-compatible API.

properties.name: groq.api.key
properties.description: API key used to authenticate requests to the Groq API.

properties.name: groq.model
properties.description: Groq chat model used for text answers.

properties.name: groq.vision.model
properties.description: Groq model used for image (vision) requests.

properties.name: groq.whisper.model
properties.description: Groq Whisper model used for audio transcription.

properties.name: groq.max-tokens
properties.description: Maximum number of tokens the model may generate per response.

properties.name: influxdb.url
properties.description: Base URL of the InfluxDB server storing presence and power history.

properties.name: influxdb.token
properties.description: InfluxDB API token used to write and query time-series data.

properties.name: influxdb.org
properties.description: InfluxDB organisation name.

properties.name: influxdb.bucket
properties.description: InfluxDB bucket that holds presence and power measurements.

properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret used to sign JWTs. Must be at least 32 bytes long.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: Access token lifetime in milliseconds.

properties.name: jwt.refresh-expiration
properties.description: Refresh token lifetime in milliseconds.

properties.name: login.max-attempts
properties.description: Number of failed login attempts allowed before the account is locked.

properties.name: login.lockout-minutes
properties.description: How long an account stays locked after too many failed logins, in minutes.

properties.name: loki.url
properties.description: Loki base URL used by AdminLogController to proxy log queries.

properties.name: mqtt.broker-url
properties.description: MQTT broker URL used for presence, power and device log messages.

properties.name: mqtt.client-id
properties.description: Client id prefix for the backend inbound and outbound MQTT adapters.

properties.name: mqtt.username
properties.description: MQTT broker username. Empty = anonymous connection (local dev); set when the broker runs with allow_anonymous=false.

properties.name: mqtt.password
properties.description: MQTT broker password, only used together with mqtt.username.

properties.name: mqtt.topic.presence
properties.description: MQTT topic pattern that carries presence messages.

properties.name: mqtt.topic.power
properties.description: MQTT topic pattern that carries power telemetry messages.

properties.name: mqtt.topic.logs
properties.description: MQTT topic pattern that carries device log messages.

properties.name: prometheus.base-url
properties.description: Prometheus base URL used by the admin Metrics page to query metric graphs.

properties.name: rate.limit.max-requests
properties.description: Number of requests allowed per client inside one rate-limit window.

properties.name: rate.limit.window-seconds
properties.description: Length of the rate-limit window in seconds.
